name: Radiator Springs Racers
description: The most beloved and critically acclaimed attraction at Disney California Adventure — Radiator Springs Racers is a spectacular dark ride racing experience through the breathtaking landscapes of Carburetor County from the Pixar film Cars. Guests board sleek racing vehicles and speed through stunning rock formations, encounter beloved Cars characters and race against a rival vehicle in a thrilling finale. Consistently voted one of the greatest theme park attractions in the world. Min 102cm.

name: Guardians of the Galaxy — Mission: BREAKOUT!
description: The most thrilling drop tower experience at any Disney park — Guardians of the Galaxy Mission BREAKOUT! transforms the iconic tower structure into a thrilling free-fall adventure featuring the Guardians of the Galaxy. Guests are blasted upward and plunge downward repeatedly in randomised sequences while a spectacular rock soundtrack plays. One of the most exhilarating and unique attractions at any Disney resort worldwide. Min 102cm.

name: WEB SLINGERS: A Spider-Man Adventure
description: A spectacular and innovative interactive attraction at Avengers Campus — WEB SLINGERS puts guests in control of web-slinging technology to capture Spider-Bots in a thrilling interactive experience. One of the most technologically advanced and immersive interactive dark rides at any theme park in the world. Suitable for all ages.

name: Soarin' Around the World
description: A breathtaking and beloved hang-gliding simulation experience at Disney California Adventure — Soarin Around the World lifts guests into a spectacular wraparound screen and takes them on a magical aerial journey over the most beautiful landscapes on Earth. The gentle breeze, authentic scents and extraordinary visuals create one of the most universally beloved theme park experiences in the world. Suitable for all ages. Min 102cm.

name: Grizzly River Run
description: The most exhilarating and refreshing whitewater rafting experience at any California theme park — Grizzly River Run takes guests through turbulent rapids and dramatic drops on a spectacular journey through the rugged wilderness of Grizzly Peak. One of the tallest and most thrilling raft rides ever built. Prepare to get very wet. Min 107cm.

name: Cars Land
description: The most immersive and spectacular themed land at any Disney park in California — Cars Land is a breathtaking full-scale recreation of Radiator Springs from the Pixar film Cars, complete with the iconic Cadillac Range rock formations glowing at sunset. Walking through Cars Land at dusk is one of the most magical experiences at any theme park in the world. Home to Radiator Springs Racers and beloved family attractions. Suitable for all ages.

name: Avengers Campus
description: A spectacular immersive Marvel superhero land at Disney California Adventure — Avengers Campus is an extraordinary fully themed land where guests can encounter Spider-Man, Black Widow, Doctor Strange and many other Marvel heroes. Home to WEB SLINGERS and featuring spectacular live character interactions, stunt shows and unique food experiences. One of the most exciting new lands at any Disney resort worldwide. Suitable for all ages.

name: Mater's Junkyard Jamboree
description: A beloved and charming spinning ride at Cars Land featuring Tow Mater and his tractor cousins spinning guests through a fun square dance. One of the most entertaining and rerideable family attractions at Disney California Adventure. Suitable for all ages.

name: Pixar Pal-A-Round
description: A spectacular giant Ferris wheel at Pixar Pier offering extraordinary panoramic views over Disneyland Resort, the Anaheim cityscape and on clear days the distant Pacific Ocean. Available in both swinging and non-swinging gondola versions. The most scenic attraction at Disney California Adventure. Suitable for all ages.

name: Pixar Pier
description: A beautifully themed seaside boardwalk at Disney California Adventure celebrating beloved Pixar films — Pixar Pier features unique Pixar-themed attractions, colourful games and extraordinary food experiences in a magical carnival atmosphere overlooking Paradise Bay. Suitable for all ages.

name: Buena Vista Street
description: A magnificent and lovingly detailed recreation of 1920s Los Angeles at the entrance to Disney California Adventure — Buena Vista Street recreates the city that Walt Disney first encountered when he arrived in Hollywood in 1923. Extraordinary architecture, period-accurate details and beloved classic Disney charm make this one of the finest themed areas at any Disney park. Suitable for all ages.

name: Incredicoaster
description: A thrilling and beloved high-speed roller coaster at Pixar Pier themed to the Incredibles — Incredicoaster launches guests through a series of loops and inversions at exhilarating speeds past spectacular Incredibles-themed show scenes. One of the most entertaining and rerideable coasters at any Disney park in the world. Min 122cm.

name: Toy Story Midway Mania!
description: A spectacular and universally beloved interactive 4D shooting gallery dark ride at Pixar Pier — Toy Story Midway Mania puts guests in the middle of a series of fantastically themed carnival midway games with beloved Toy Story characters. One of the most popular and rerideable attractions at any Disney resort worldwide. Suitable for all ages.
